bug_report.doc: Submit a bug report from the current user. Reads all fields from the vars input object, serializes any nested objects to JSON strings, then calls the support_bug_report stored procedure with the extracted fields.

vars.description: Bug report data object. Nested object values are auto-serialized to JSON strings before storage.

feature.description: Feature or area of the application where the bug occurred

location.description: URL or location in the application where the bug was encountered

frequency.description: How often the bug occurs (e.g. always, sometimes, rarely)

returns.description: Confirmation data from support_bug_report stored procedure

leave_comment.doc: Submit a feedback comment. Calls feedback_create stored procedure with the provided message. Available to anonymous users.

returns.description: Confirmation data from feedback_create stored procedure

contact.doc: Resolve the account that answers Contact Support, so the client can open a 1:1 conversation with it. Reads the support_contact key from yp.sys_conf (an entity id or an email) and resolves it through drumate_exists. Answers {configured:0} when no key is set or the named account no longer exists, so the caller can fall back to the support mail link.

returns.description: {configured, is_self, entity_id, firstname, lastname, display} when a support account is resolved; {configured: 0} otherwise.

list_feedback.doc: List all submitted feedback with sorting and pagination. Requires special_access preproc with remit level 1. Calls support_list_feedback stored procedure with column, order, and page parameters.

sort_by.description: Column to sort results by. Defaults to 'date'.

returns.description: Paginated list of feedback records from support_list_feedback stored procedure
